name: Coffee C
read: Coffee C Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 271.65, 96 days to expiry 2027-02-10): at-the-money implied vol 38.5%, +0.2 pts vs 2026-10-30. 20-day realized vol 28.3%, so options trade at a premium of 10.2 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +0.3 (balanced). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-10-26 to 2026-11-06) call open interest rose 27,125 and puts rose 5,052; put/call OI 1.78 → 1.39, front futures 300.95 → 271.65. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +5,146 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 48.4% → 38.5%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 300 calls (3,058 lots) and 200 puts (3,953). Biggest 5-session builds: May 27 280 calls +2,950; May 27 290 calls +2,950. Biggest cut: Dec 26 240 puts -2,854.
